<span style="font-size:20px;">Dreaming and Dreamwalking</span>

<p style="margin-top:0.4em;margin-bottom:0.5em;">I have noticed that people on here seem to get very confused about Dreaming and Dreamwalking. I appreciate that they are easily mixed up but I've edited about 6 pages in the last 36 hours that have all got it wrong one way or the other and I've no doubt I will see many more, so I'm going to post this both here and on the Dreamwalking page in the hope that people will read it and understand.</p>

So, to clarify: [http://wot.wikia.com/wiki/Dreamwalking Dreamwalking] is the ability to enter ''[http://wot.wikia.com/wiki/Tel%27aran%27rhiod Tel'aran'rhiod]'' at will while sleeping. [http://wot.wikia.com/wiki/Dreaming Dreaming] is the Talent of having prophetic dreams that show possible futures. It is assumed that all Dreamers are also Dreamwalkers, but few Dreamwalkers are Dreamers. [http://wot.wikia.com/wiki/Egwene Egwene ]is an example of one who is both, as well as some of the [http://wot.wikia.com/wiki/Wise_Ones Wise Ones] .
